triggers.name: ultrawork
triggers.inject: Ultrawork mode: maximize agent utilization and tool execution. Use subagents for exploration/analysis and verify results before answering.

triggers.name: search
triggers.inject: Search mode: Use list_files for file name search, search_files for content search. Prefer parallel tool calls. Widen coverage and delegate to subagents when exploration is heavy.

triggers.name: analyze
triggers.inject: Analyze mode: Read files first before analysis. Gather context before conclusions. Validate assumptions. Use subagents for specialized reasoning if needed.

triggers.name: file_operations
triggers.inject: File reading mode: Use read_file tool (NOT cat/head/tail). If multiple files, use parallel read_file calls for efficiency.

triggers.name: edit_modify
triggers.pattern: (?i)\b(edit|modify|change|update|fix|correct|refactor|改|修改|編輯|更新|重構)\b.*\b(file|code|檔案|程式碼|代碼)\b
triggers.inject: File editing mode: MUST read_file first to understand content, then use edit_file with precise old_string/new_string. NEVER edit without reading first.

triggers.name: batch_operations
triggers.inject: Batch operation mode: Use list_files or search_files to find targets first. If <5 files, use parallel tool calls. If >5 files, ask user to confirm or process in batches.

triggers.name: code_development
triggers.pattern: (?i)\b(code|program|script|develop|implement|build|create|寫|開發|建立|實作)\b.*(function|class|module|功能|函數|類別|模組)\b
triggers.inject: Development mode: Read existing code first. Follow project patterns. Use edit_file for modifications. Avoid over-engineering. Only do what's requested.

triggers.name: git_operations
triggers.inject: Git mode: Follow git safety protocol. NEVER force push, skip hooks, or modify config. Read files before commit. Use descriptive commit messages with Co-Authored-By tag.

triggers.name: document_processing
triggers.inject: Document processing mode: Check for relevant skills (pdf, docx, excel). Activate skill if available. Use skill scripts and follow skill instructions completely.

triggers.name: performance_efficiency
triggers.inject: Performance mode: Maximize parallel tool calls. Use specialized tools over bash. Avoid sequential calls when operations are independent.

triggers.name: task_planning
triggers.inject: Task planning mode: Create task list with TodoWrite if multiple steps (>3). Mark tasks as in_progress/completed in real-time. Only one task in_progress at a time.

triggers.name: directory_navigation
triggers.inject: Directory exploration mode: Use list_directory for directory contents. Use list_files with glob patterns for recursive search. Build understanding of project structure.

triggers.name: web_search_required
triggers.pattern: (?i)\b(latest|newest|recent|current|now|today|最新|最近|現在|今天|目前|當前|new|更新|update)\b
triggers.inject: Web search mode: This query involves current/recent information. MUST use web_search FIRST before answering. Always include source URLs in response.

triggers.name: news_events
triggers.inject: News/Events mode: MUST search the web for current information. Verify facts from multiple sources. Include publication dates and source URLs.

triggers.name: product_tech_info
triggers.pattern: (?i)\b(version|release|feature|spec|specification|price|版本|功能|規格|價格|發布|特性)\b
triggers.inject: Product/Tech info mode: Product and technology information changes frequently. MUST search for latest specifications, versions, and features. Include official documentation URLs.

triggers.name: market_trends
triggers.inject: Trends mode: Trend information is time-sensitive. MUST search the web for current trends. Include sources and timeframe of data.

triggers.name: comparison_questions
triggers.inject: Comparison mode: When comparing products/technologies, search for latest information about ALL items being compared. Ensure information is from the same timeframe.
